en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a forested ravine with a high concrete arch road bridge crossing above a narrow waterway. Below, a passenger boat full of people travels along an elevated canal or aqueduct through the gorge. On the right, rocky slopes rise steeply with pine trees and a small pavilion-like structure at the top. Printed captions in Swedish are visible in the lower left and right corners.
